notes.title: March Update – Crimson Waves Scripting
notes.notes:
March is halfway over so it’s time to take a look at progress from the past 2 weeks!

We’ve been chipping away at the game, and our main progress this month has been in the writing section and the programming section.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45086109/1569157ef0acac8b5cf9e3c2968f3859acd642ae.png

For the writing, Runa has refined the outline and some of the finer points of the mystery as well as upcoming scene variation planning. Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea: Amaranthine Moon is a mystery visual novel as well as an otome, so careful consideration goes into laying out clues as well as laying out the romance. It should be solvable and make sense as to why things happened the way they did.

CWES: Amaranthine Moon also gives players a variety of choices outside of which love interest they want to be with, most notably if Lucie should be a vampire or not. Lucie is a human at the beginning of the game, but only because she’s been taking the cure to vampirism. If the player decides to not let her take the cure anymore, Lucie goes back to being a vampire. This can change how events happen drastically in some parts of the story—you’ll just have to try it and see in the full game!

The other area we made progress in was in the programming department, which is my area! I was busy scripting some of the scenes past the demo area. Not all of this was working on the post-demo parts, because I also had to set up some additional things (like additional expressions, color tints, backgrounds) to future proof the work.

Here’s a preview of one of the scenes!

[previewyoutube=yQ_NIZYqbr0;full][/previewyoutube]

My personal goal for the rest of March is to finish scripting the 3rd day so it’ll be fully playable up to that point.

Last but not least, we have this lovely artwork of Lucie, illustrated by Kiwi~

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45086109/dd0cc7d26bf7c25a38909e89b57674bd45241179.jpg

p.s. if you haven’t already, follow the Kickstarter page for our upcoming crowdfunding campaign!

— Arimia

notes.title: January Update – Crimson Waves Artwork
notes.notes:
As mentioned in our last devlog, we’re going to be doing 2 every month to update on our 2 games, Asphodelium and Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea: Amaranthine Moon. Now that it’s the end of the month, we’re taking a look at the progress on CWES: Amaranthine Moon.

It’s hard to believe January has already passed! We’ve had a lot of progress on the project the past few weeks, so let’s take a look at it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45086109/f6b1f17d76b5a0582d68506b00c50734e192583f.jpg

First off, we have a preview of Ambrose’s updated sprite artwork by Dule! The sprite is almost done and will be part of our next demo update. We also hope to have Nemo’s updated sprite soon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45086109/ef0c53b834d6fa0ab6c0bc137130acd0f209ac7e.jpg

We’re also doing some updates to the GUI to make it a more cohesive experience, such as adding golden embellishments to the cut-ins.

As you can see, we’re also making progress on scripting in the next parts of the game, as day 3 is fully written and being programmed. The script has passed 40k words and is coming along well.

We were hoping to release CWES: Amaranthine Moon in Q1 2025, but we’re going to keep working on it for a few more months to give it the time it needs, as the story has expanded to fully flesh out the love interests.

We also have some brand new extra art, such as Lucie (illustrated by me)…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45086109/2acc5974049456e627a0f5fad7d723b0e96dda09.jpg

…and a new key visual artwork, illustrated by noa000!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45086109/cfea9273ffa1752b6aea456d8d6b53000a2c614d.jpg

If you haven’t already, wishlist it on Steam, as every wishlist helps us out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3072470/Crimson_Waves_on_the_Emerald_Sea_Amaranthine_Moon/

As a last announcement… We’ll be holding a small Kickstarter for the game later this year! There will be a few rewards such as keychains, stickers, physical copies of the game, and more. You can follow the Kickstarter page to see when it goes live!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45086109/3f81a7dd993afb66cff21044815cbbaa5caa16c9.png

p.s. we’ll be hosting the first ever otome-themed Steam festival in May to coincide with the annual Otome Game Jam, so stay tuned for that!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45086109/97f08a3edef62942883dd7d4fc9259667f651b01.png

— Arimia
